RCPE.name: Recipe
RCPE.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas RCPE record. DATA is a fixed 16-byte struct, which matches the single measured size of 16 across all 105 instances in FalloutNV.esm.

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas RCPE wbStruct(DATA): Skill (ActorValue enum, itS32), Level (itU32), Category (RCCT or NULL FormID), Sub-Category (RCCT FormID)

RCIL.name: Item
RCIL.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas wbIngredient wbFormIDCk(RCIL, 'Item'); ingredient list entry, repeated per ingredient

RCQY.name: Quantity
RCQY.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas wbIngredient/wbOutput wbInteger(RCQY, 'Quantity', itU32); stored after each RCIL/RCOD item

RCOD.name: Item
RCOD.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas wbOutput wbFormIDCk(RCOD, 'Item'); output list entry, repeated per output

CDCK.name: Caravan Deck
CDCK.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas CDCK record; no header flags declared

CARD.name: Card
CARD.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas CDCK wbRArrayS('Cards', wbFormIDCk(CARD, 'Card', [CCRD])); measured 572 instances all exactly 4 bytes, so formid is confirmed against real data

DATA.name: Count (broken)
DATA.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas CDCK record: wbInteger(DATA, 'Count (broken)', itU32). Verified: 13 instances across the six masters, all exactly 4 bytes

ANAM.name: Camera Paths
ANAM.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas CPTH wbStruct(ANAM): Parent and Previous, both CPTH-or-NULL FormIDs. 418 instances all measured exactly 8 bytes.

DATA.name: Camera Zoom
DATA.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas CPTH wbInteger(DATA, 'Camera Zoom', itU8); 418 instances all exactly 1 byte

SNAM.name: Camera Shot
SNAM.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas CPTH wbRArray('Camera Shots', wbFormIDCk(SNAM, 'Camera Shot', [CAMS])); 484 instances all exactly 4 bytes

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas CAMS wbStruct(DATA): Action/Location/Target enums (itU32), Flags (itU32), Player/Target/Global time multipliers (f32), then Max Time, Min Time, Target % Between Actors (f32). 272 of 276 instances are 40 bytes; 4 are 36 bytes, missing only the final float, expressed here as a size-decided union so neither size errors.

MNAM.name: Image Space Modifier
MNAM.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsCommon.pas wbGenericModel (ISMod entry); 275 instances all exactly 4 bytes

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas ARMA wbStruct(DATA): Value, Max Condition (itS32), Weight (f32). 131 instances all exactly 12 bytes.

DNAM.name: Data
DNAM.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas ARMA wbStruct(DNAM) with SetOptionalFrom(2): DR (itS16), Modulates Voice flag (itU16), DT (f32), 4 unused bytes. SetOptionalFrom(2) makes everything from index 2 optional, so a 4-byte DNAM is DR+Flags only and a 12-byte one is all four fields; 115 of 131 instances are 4 bytes, 16 are 12. DT and the trailing bytes are both optional here.

MODS.name: Alternate Textures
MODS.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas wbMODS = wbArrayS(MODS, 'Alternate Textures', wbAlternateTexture, -1), i.e. a u32 count then that many (len_string 3D Name, TXST FormID, i32 3D Index). Verified against real bytes on every ARMA MODS: e.g. 01000000 0b000000 'PARightHand' 00060c00 00000000 parses exactly with zero bytes left.

MO2S.name: Alternate Textures
MO2S.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas wbMO2S = wbArrayS(MO2S, 'Alternate Textures', wbAlternateTexture, -1); same element as MODS, applied to the World Model ([MOD2, MO2T])

MO3S.name: Alternate Textures
MO3S.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas wbMO3S = wbArrayS(MO3S, 'Alternate Textures', wbAlternateTexture, -1); same element as MODS, applied to the Biped Model ([MOD3, MO3T])

MO4S.name: Alternate Textures
MO4S.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas wbMO4S = wbArrayS(MO4S, 'Alternate Textures', wbAlternateTexture, -1); same element as MODS

BMDT.name: Biped Data
BMDT.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas wbBMDT helper record, used by both ARMO and ARMA (wbRecord(ARMA, ...) includes wbBMDT at line 4004). Same layout on both: [u32 biped flags][u8 general flags][3 unused]. Verified over 520 instances in the shipped masters, all exactly 8 bytes.

DNAM.name: Flags
DNAM.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas VTYP wbInteger(DNAM, 'Flags', itU8); 91 instances all exactly 1 byte

ANAM.name: Short Name
ANAM.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas AVIF wbStringKC(ANAM, 'Short Name', 0, cpTranslate); a plain string in every FNV use. Measured sizes vary from 4 to 12 bytes, consistent with a null-terminated string rather than a fixed-size field.

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas ECZN wbStruct(DATA): Owner (NPC_/FACT/NULL FormID), Rank (itS8), Minimum Level (itS8), Flags (itU8: Never Resets, Match PC Below Minimum Level), 1 unused byte. 17 instances all exactly 8 bytes.

DEBR.name: Debris
DEBR.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas DEBR record: wbRArray('Models', wbDebrisModel(wbModelInfo(MODT)), cpNormal, True), i.e. a repeating (DATA, MODT) pair

MODT.name: Model Texture Hashes
MODT.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsCommon.pas wbModelInfo, passed to wbDebrisModel; same 24-byte-per-entry layout as the common MODT

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsCommon.pas wbDebrisModel: wbStruct(DATA, 'Data', [wbInteger('Percentage', itU8), wbString('Model FileName'), wbInteger('Has Collision', itU8, wbBoolEnum)]).SetRequired. The middle string is xEdit's plain wbString (NUL-terminated, not rest-of-field), which the new `cstring` primitive expresses. Verified: all 26 instances in FalloutNV.esm follow [u8][NUL-terminated name][u8] exactly (e.g. 0f 'Gore\RoboBit01.NIF' 01)

NVER.name: Version
NVER.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas RGDL wbInteger(NVER, 'Version', itU32); 38 instances all exactly 4 bytes

DATA.name: General Data
DATA.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas RGDL wbStruct(DATA): Dynamic Bone Count (itU32), 4 unused bytes, five bool enums (Feedback, Foot IK, Look IK, Grab IK, Pose Matching), 1 unused byte. 38 instances all exactly 14 bytes.

XNAM.name: Actor Base
XNAM.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas RGDL wbFormIDCk(XNAM, 'Actor Base', [CREA, NPC_]); 31 instances all exactly 4 bytes

TNAM.name: Body Part Data
TNAM.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas RGDL wbFormIDCk(TNAM, 'Body Part Data', [BPTD]); 38 instances all exactly 4 bytes

RAFD.name: Feedback Data
RAFD.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas RGDL wbStruct(RAFD): seven f32 gains, a 4x f32 Snap Max Settings, a 2x f32 Position Max Velocity, then Projectile and Melee (itS32, wbDiv(1000)). 38 instances all exactly 60 bytes.

RAFB.name: Feedback Dynamic Bones
RAFB.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas RGDL wbArray(RAFB, 'Feedback Dynamic Bones', wbInteger('Bone', itU16)); fill-to-end, no count subrecord

RAPS.name: Pose Matching Data
RAPS.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas RGDL wbStruct(RAPS): 3x Bone (itU16, wbHideFFFF), Flags (itU8: Disable On Move), 1 unused byte, then Motors Strength, Pose Activation Delay Time, Match Error Allowance, Displacement To Disable (f32). 38 instances all exactly 24 bytes.

ANAM.name: Death Pose
ANAM.note: xEdit wbDefinitionsFNV.pas RGDL wbString(ANAM, 'Death Pose'); a plain string in every FNV use. Measured sizes vary (31-44 bytes), consistent with a null-terminated string.
